build_radius_graph_pbc: build a radial cutoff graph with periodic boundary conditions for crystal atom positions
compute_pbc_distances: compute pairwise distances between atoms corrected for periodic boundary conditions using cell offsets
compute_neighbors_per_image: compute the number of neighbors per image from an edge index and atom counts
filter_max_neighbors: filter edges so each atom has at most a threshold number of nearest neighbors
review_radius_graph_pbc: review the radius_graph_pbc function to understand how unit cell repetitions are calculated
